Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
Caroline Valez is in combat with a Tunnel Runner. Tunnel Runner plays Carrion Crows. Caroline doesn't dodge or S:CE. Does she take a damage from the Carrion Crows?
>
> Carolina Vález
> Clan: Lasombra
> Group: 5
> Capacity: 9
> Discipline: aus DOM OBT POT PRE
> Sabbat Archbishop of Montreal: Carolina is immune to damage from allies and retainers.
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Carrion Crows' damage isn't dealt by the Tunnel Runner. Carolina isn't immune to that damage.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Carrion Crows' damage isn't dealt by the Tunnel Runner. Carolina isn't immune to that damage.
>
More precisely: Carrion Crows' damage is environmental. Carolina isn't immune to that damage.

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Yes but its specifically damage from the retainer, which she is immune to. Carrion Crows is not damage from the ally.

Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> And I don't use the term "environmental" as it is not defined by the rules.
>
www.vekn.net/index.php/general-rulings
Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if the damage is from a strike or if an effect specifically states that the damage is dealt by the minion. Damage from other effects is considered "environmental," and has no particular source. [RTR 19970630]
